 KUANTAN: A motorcyclist has survived after he was swept away by strong currents during a flash flood here.
 The Bentong district disaster management committee secretariat said in a statement on Thursday (Nov 19) that the incident occurred at about 8pm on Wednesday (Nov 18) when the 44-year-old victim was on Jalan Utama Kemasul headed home to Agropolitan Chemomoi (Sungai Poh).
 "While attempting to wade through the flooded stretch, the victim was swept away by strong currents. He managed to save himself but sustained minor injuries, including cuts, scratches from thorns, a sprained leg and a swollen knee.
 "The victim was subsequently taken to the Chemomoi Health Clinic for further treatment," the statement read. – Bernama
